subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Circling back on my earlier email about validated leads for {Brand}. As listing marketplaces like Facebook Marketplace and OfferUp lean harder on transaction take, acquisition economics are tightening: US ecommerce CAC now runs $21 to $377 per customer by category (Shopify 2025) against a 10 to 30 percent marketplace take rate (Sharetribe 2025). That spread is where contact screening and incrementality decide your real cost per validated lead. We hold paid leads against a holdout, so what we add shows as incremental to your organic traffic. Worth comparing against your source mix?
angle: fresh angle: take-rate-driven CAC pressure across listing marketplaces (sourced) + US ecommerce CAC band vs marketplace take rate
register_notes: Stage 2 EN classifieds: acknowledges second follow-up and references prior email in first sentence; fresh angle = timely structural development (listing marketplaces leaning on transaction take, raising acquisition pressure) anchored to two web-verified market bands, US ecommerce CAC $21-$377 (Shopify 2025) and 10-30 percent marketplace take rate (Sharetribe 2025), both URLs in enrichment_sources; MobUpps holdout/incrementality referenced with no figure; no MobUpps illustrative figure this stage; exactly one question mark; no sign-off; native US business English; no hedge before the number; no 'X, not Y'; only in-set brands named (Facebook Marketplace, OfferUp from brand_candidates); no brand named outside brand_candidates; no cross-border giant as a local rival.
